non_substitution_law: Ack can confirm receipt or settlement while the business side effect is absent, failed, or later compensated.
A client API and retry policy are not the server's persistence or settlement behavior.
A command asks an authority to act; an event asserts a fact already recorded.
DLQ diversion is mechanical; quarantine adds custody, correction authority, evidence, and release decision.
Internal language and evolution authority differ from a stable published language.
Occurrence time, broker observation time, and computation time answer different questions.
Intent and guarantees survive protocol replacement; framing and handshakes do not.
Occurrence identity detects repeated transport records; the business key scopes effect equivalence.
A documented offer is not proof that one occurrence enables, preserves, or qualifies it.
Per-lane order does not compare records in different lanes.
A protocol permits multiple implementations and does not attest a broker configuration.
Persistence or transport settlement does not prove authorization, validation, or domain commit.
Redelivery follows unsettled delivery; replay deliberately selects retained history under a new run/attempt.
Retry creates a new attempt; redelivery presents the same transport occurrence again.
